post_title: India AI Summit: Google $15B Hub, Tata AI Data Center, OpenAI-TCS Deal

sections.title: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 Closes the Gap with Opus-Class Intelligence at Sonnet Pricing
sections.lead: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.6, its second major model upgrade in under two weeks, approaching Opus-class intelligence while maintaining Sonnet 4.5 pricing.

sections.title: Moonshot AI Open-Sources Kimi K2.5 and Ships Kimi Code Agent
sections.lead: Moonshot AI released Kimi K2.5, a native multimodal model trained on 15 trillion tokens, alongside Kimi Code — a coding agent supporting image and video inputs in terminals and IDEs.

sections.title: OpenAI GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Delivers 1,000+ Tokens Per Second for Real-Time Coding
sections.lead: OpenAI unveiled a research preview of GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, its first model optimized for real-time coding, in partnership with Cerebras.

sections.title: DeepSeek V3.2 and Allen AI OLMo 3 Advance Open Reasoning and Math Benchmarks
sections.lead: DeepSeek launched V3.2, a 685B-parameter flagship with a reasoning-enhanced Speciale variant; Allen AI released OLMo 3 in fully open 7B and 32B sizes.

sections.title: Meta-NVIDIA Long-Term AI Infrastructure Deal Scales Training and Private AI Features
sections.lead: Meta and NVIDIA announced a multi-year partnership supplying Vera Rubin platform chips, Spectrum-X Ethernet, and Confidential Computing for WhatsApp.

sections.title: OpenAI-Snowflake $200M Integration Embeds AI Agents in Enterprise Data Workflows
sections.lead: OpenAI and Snowflake agreed on a $200 million deal to natively integrate OpenAI models into Snowflake Cortex AI.

sections.title: Open-Source Surge in Reasoning and Coding Models Challenges Proprietary Ecosystems
sections.lead: Labs including Moonshot, DeepSeek, Prime Intellect, and Allen AI released open models with full weights, training stacks, and MIT licenses — topping benchmarks in math, code, and reasoning.

sections.title: Real-Time Developer Tools Race Intensifies as Latency Becomes the Key Metric
sections.lead: OpenAI's Codex-Spark and Moonshot's Kimi Code exemplify a surge in low-latency coding agents supporting multimodal inputs and 1,000+ tokens-per-second speeds.
